notes: Flagged large unit reviewed and retained: מִן + לְ + פְּנֵי is one compound rendering answering to the single of, headed on the construct noun under rule 23, with the suffix taking thee separately; come is the linking verb rule 20 hands to the prepositional predicate.
Both is given to the first waw rather than read as half a correlative pair belonging to the second, since two waws stand in the phrase and two connectives are written (rules 14, 42).
The anticipatory it of in thy hand it is to make great is added under rule 25's expletive paragraph: it denotes nothing the verse names.
